description.blurb: Jason-2/OSTM used high-precision ocean altimetry to measure the distance between the satellite and the ocean surface to within a few centimeters.
description.more: The third in a series of sea level missions, Jason-2/Ocean Surface Topography Mission follows the TOPEX/Poseiden and Jason-1 missions. These very accurate observations of variations in sea surface height — also known as ocean topography — provide information about global sea level, the speed and direction of ocean currents, and heat stored in the ocean.
